gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: Umfanekiso omkhulu, i-GIF okanye ividiyo enesihloko nesicatshulwa phezu kwayo, ebekwe naphi na ephepheni.

configure.title: Umfanekiso okanye ividiyo
configure.description: Ifayile ye-JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 okanye WebM.

configure.title: Isicatshulwa esingenye indlela
configure.description: Chaza umfanekiso. Shiya kungenanto xa ungowokuhombisa kuphela.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko esiboniswa phezu kwemidiya. Shiya kungenanto ukuba awusifuni.

configure.title: Isicatshulwa
configure.description: Isicatshulwa esiboniswa phantsi kwesihloko, phezu kwemidiya.

configure.title: Ububanzi obupheleleyo
configure.description: Hamba ukusuka kumphetho ukuya kumphetho endaweni yokuhlala kwikholamu yomxholo.

configure.title: Ukwakha isakhelo
configure.description: Indlela ifoto ehlala ngayo kubungakanani besikrini ngabunye

advanced.title: Ukufiphala
advanced.description: Umbala obekwe phezu kwemidiya. Xa kukho isihloko okanye isicatshulwa uhlala ukhona, ukuze isicatshulwa sihlale sifundeka.

advanced.title: Indawo yokugxila ecaleni
advanced.description: Inxalenye yomfanekiso ehlala ibonakala xa isikiwe, ukusuka ku-0 (ekhohlo) ukuya ku-100 (ekunene).

advanced.title: Indawo yokugxila ezantsi
advanced.description: Inxalenye yomfanekiso ehlala ibonakala xa isikiwe, ukusuka ku-0 (phezulu) ukuya ku-100 (ezantsi).
